reported_outcome.basis: Author report, with per-person basis confirmed; not a controlled savings benchmark.

definitions.listing_captures: Captured occurrences, including repeat searches and syndicated listings.
definitions.consolidated_listing_records: Canonical records; unresolved identities remain, so this is not a count of proven unique physical apartments.
definitions.broad_candidate_screen_records: Historical export: advertised 4+ bedrooms, 2+ full bathrooms, rent <=7500, excluding classifications containing reject, not_eligible or ambiguous_bed_count. Records still needed verification. This historical screen is not the current missing-data policy.
definitions.commute_origins: Locations submitted to the historical commute model; route availability differs by mode.
definitions.weekly_departure_slots: Quarter-hour departure slots across a representative week, with equivalent transit service days reused. Not distinct route computations or measured trips.

privacy: Aggregate values only. Original evidence files, addresses and household destinations remain private.
